classes.description: A taxpayer who may qualify as a surviving spouse.
classes.supporting_span: the term "surviving spouse" means a taxpayer

classes.description: A taxpayer satisfying the statutory surviving-spouse conditions.
Household maintained by the taxpayer as a principal place of abode for a dependent.
classes.supporting_span: maintains as his home a household

classes.description: The taxable year relevant to surviving-spouse determination.
A single joint return of income taxes.
A husband or wife who is a nonresident alien during the taxable year.

predicates.description: Taxpayer's spouse died during either of the two years immediately preceding the taxable year.
predicates.supporting_span: whose spouse died during either of the two years immediately preceding the taxable year

predicates.description: Taxpayer maintains a household as home.
predicates.supporting_span: maintains as his home a household

predicates.description: Household is the dependent's principal place of abode for the taxable year.
predicates.supporting_span: constitutes for the taxable year the principal place of abode ... of a dependent

predicates.description: Dependent is a son, stepson, daughter, or stepdaughter of the taxpayer.
predicates.supporting_span: is a son, stepson, daughter, or stepdaughter of the taxpayer

predicates.description: Taxpayer is entitled to a deduction for the dependent under section 151.
predicates.supporting_span: with respect to whom the taxpayer is entitled to a deduction for the taxable year under section 151

predicates.description: Taxpayer furnished over half the cost of maintaining the household.
predicates.supporting_span: over half of the cost of maintaining the household during the taxable year is furnished by such individual

predicates.description: Taxpayer remarried before the close of the taxable year.
predicates.supporting_span: if the taxpayer has remarried at any time before the close of the taxable year

predicates.description: A joint return could have been made for the taxable year during which the spouse died.
predicates.supporting_span: unless, for the taxpayer's taxable year during which his spouse died, a joint return could have been made

predicates.description: Either spouse is a nonresident alien during the taxable year.
predicates.supporting_span: no joint return shall be made if either the husband or wife at any time during the taxable year is a nonresident alien

predicates.description: Taxpayer qualifies as a surviving spouse for purposes of section 1.
predicates.supporting_span: the term "surviving spouse" means a taxpayer

rules.supporting_span: the term "surviving spouse" means a taxpayer- (A) whose spouse died during either of the two years immediately preceding the taxable year, and (B) who maintains as his home a household ... of a dependent ... with respect to whom the taxpayer is entitled to a deduction ...
rules.explanation: Main surviving-spouse qualification rule with household, dependent, deduction, remarriage, joint-return, and nonresident-alien limitations.

rules.supporting_span: a taxpayer shall not be considered to be a surviving spouse- (A) if the taxpayer has remarried at any time before the close of the taxable year
rules.explanation: Remarriage before the close of taxable year prevents surviving-spouse status.

rules.supporting_span: unless, for the taxpayer's taxable year during which his spouse died, a joint return could have been made
rules.explanation: Surviving-spouse status requires that a joint return could have been made in the year of spouse's death.

rules.supporting_span: no joint return shall be made if either the husband or wife at any time during the taxable year is a nonresident alien
rules.explanation: Nonresident-alien status prevents a joint return.
